name: EPIC 220634712
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 8, 18.1 solar radii and 2.91 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 5,405 parsecs away, 18 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 2.91 solar masses and 18.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,188 K at its surface.
